Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ggboundary 0.1.0

First release.

  • geom_boundary() shades overshoot and slack between a value trajectory and a fixed or moving boundary on Cartesian coordinates, as a facet-safe list of ggplot2 layers.
  • boundary_plot() wraps it into a themed one-call figure and reports the share of the series in overshoot.
  • doughnut() draws the static Doughnut Economics chart (the polar snapshot).
  • conch() / spiral_boundary() wind the same trajectory into a log-spiral as an expressive companion.

Developed by Rendell de Kort.
